The '''Peace Brigade''' was a relief organization formed after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It would send help to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were abandoned to the Empire as part of the treaty and give humanitarian aid to their citizens. [[Corso Riggs]] was a member of the brigade for several years, until a Separatist attack on his home village forced him to return to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
